title: API token (apify_api_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: APIFY_API_ vs the case-sensitive apify_api_. Twin of "API token (apify_api_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of apify-api-token-dotenv: prefix: APIFY_API_ vs the case-sensitive apify_api_. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
